info.title: Dugble API
info.description: Programmatic access to Dugble email, SMS, sending infrastructure, contacts, audiences, suppressions, and broadcasts. Authenticate with a team token sent as a Bearer token.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Create, version, publish, preview, and test reusable email templates.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Manage contacts and their audience memberships.

tags.name: Contact Properties
tags.description: Manage typed custom property definitions used by contacts.

tags.name: Broadcasts
tags.description: Create, schedule, and analyze email broadcasts.

get.description: Returns email messages belonging to the authenticated team.

post.description: Queues an email for immediate or scheduled delivery.

Location.description: Relative URL of the queued email.

post.description: Atomically queues up to 50 emails. Attachments are not supported in batch requests. A top-level array is preferred; an object containing a `messages` array is also accepted.

202.description: All emails accepted for asynchronous delivery.

get.description: Returns team-wide email delivery, open, click, and bounce analytics for fixed 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day windows.
Retrieves a single email message by its Dugble message ID.

patch.description: Reschedules a pending scheduled email. The new scheduled_at value must be a future RFC 3339 timestamp.

post.description: Cancels an email that is still queued for scheduled delivery.

get.description: Returns delivery events for an email message.
Returns SMS messages belonging to the authenticated team.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by exact normalized SMS status.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: Filter by exact sender identity matching the response `from` value.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Include messages created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Include messages created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp. Must not precede start_date.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match across recipient, sender, body, or provider message ID.

post.description: Queues an SMS for immediate or scheduled delivery. Recipient numbers must use international format.

Location.description: Relative URL of the queued SMS.

post.description: Atomically validates, prices, charges, and queues up to 50 SMS messages. A top-level array is preferred; an object containing a `messages` array is also accepted.

202.description: All SMS messages accepted for asynchronous delivery.

get.description: Returns team-wide SMS delivery analytics for fixed 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day windows plus 90-day delivery totals by destination country.
Retrieves a single SMS message by its Dugble message ID.

patch.description: Reschedules a pending scheduled SMS outside the delivery cutoff. The new scheduled_at value must be a future RFC 3339 timestamp at least 30 seconds ahead.

post.description: Cancels a pending scheduled SMS outside the final 15-second delivery cutoff.

get.description: Returns delivery events for an SMS message.

post.description: Refreshes the delivery status from the SMS provider.

get.description: Returns reusable email templates for the authenticated team using limit/offset pagination.

post.description: Creates a reusable email template and its initial draft version.

get.description: Retrieves a template by UUID or alias, including its current draft content and publish state.

patch.description: Updates template metadata or content and creates a new current draft version.

post.description: Publishes the template's current version. The current version must have a non-empty subject and valid content.
Duplicates the template's current version into a new draft template. The generated name defaults to the source name plus ' Copy'.

get.description: Returns template versions using limit/offset pagination.
Retrieves a specific immutable template version.

post.description: Creates a new current draft version by copying content from the selected historical version.
Renders the current or requested template version with optional variable values without sending it.
Renders the current or requested version and queues a test email to one recipient.

202.description: Template test email accepted for delivery.

get.description: Returns sending domains configured for the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates and provisions a sending domain. Provisioning may be asynchronous while email infrastructure is being prepared.

202.description: Domain accepted while infrastructure provisioning completes.

get.description: Retrieves a sending domain and its current verification state.

patch.description: Updates mutable configuration for a sending domain. Currently only the TLS mode can be changed.

delete.description: Removes a sending domain from the authenticated team.

post.description: Checks the domain's provider and DNS verification state and returns the updated domain.

get.description: Returns SMS sender IDs belonging to the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a new SMS sender ID for a specific country and sending purpose.

get.description: Retrieves a single SMS sender ID and its current approval status.

delete.description: Deactivates the sender ID and returns its updated state.

get.description: Returns contacts belonging to the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a contact with email, phone, consent, and custom property data.

get.description: Retrieves a single contact by ID.

patch.description: Updates the mutable fields of an existing contact.

delete.description: Deletes a contact from the authenticated team.

get.description: Returns the topics associated with a contact and the contact's subscription state for each topic.

patch.description: Updates a contact's opt-in or opt-out state for one or more topics.

get.description: Returns the segments that currently include the contact.

post.description: Adds a contact to a segment. Repeating the operation for an existing membership is safe.

200.description: The contact was already a member of the segment.

delete.description: Removes a contact's membership from a segment.

get.description: Returns contact property definitions configured for the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a typed custom property definition for contacts. Property keys are unique within the team.

get.description: Retrieves a single contact property definition by ID.

patch.description: Replaces the fallback value for a contact property. Send `null` to clear the fallback value.

delete.description: Deletes a contact property definition from the authenticated team.

get.description: Returns subscription topics configured for the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a subscription topic with a default subscription state and visibility.

get.description: Retrieves a single subscription topic by ID.

patch.description: Updates the name, description, or visibility of a subscription topic.

delete.description: Deletes a subscription topic from the authenticated team.

get.description: Returns audience segments belonging to the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a new audience segment for organizing contacts.

get.description: Retrieves a single audience segment by ID.

delete.description: Deletes an audience segment from the authenticated team.

get.description: Returns the current number of contacts assigned to the segment. This is raw segment membership and does not apply unsubscribe, topic, or suppression eligibility rules.
Returns contacts that are currently members of the segment.
Returns suppressed email addresses for the authenticated team, optionally filtered by origin.

post.description: Adds an email address to the team's suppression list.
Adds up to 100 email addresses to the team's suppression list in one request.
Removes up to 100 suppressions by email address or suppression ID. Provide either `emails` or `ids`, but not both.

get.description: Retrieves a suppression by UUID or email address.

delete.description: Removes a suppression by UUID or email address.

get.description: Returns broadcasts belonging to the authenticated team.

post.description: Creates a broadcast with its own sender and email content. By default the broadcast is a draft; set send to true to queue immediately or combine send with a future scheduled_at to schedule it.

example.name: August product update
example.subject: What's new this month
example.preview_text: A quick look at what shipped.

get.description: Retrieves a single broadcast by ID, including its current delivery state and audience counts.

patch.description: Updates a draft or scheduled broadcast. Supply the current revision for optimistic concurrency control; nullable content fields can be cleared with JSON null.

delete.description: Deletes a broadcast that is still in draft or canceled state.

post.description: Queues a draft broadcast immediately, or schedules it when `scheduled_at` is supplied.

202.description: Broadcast accepted for sending or scheduling.

post.description: Cancels active scheduling or execution. Scheduled broadcasts return to draft; queued broadcasts move to canceled and remaining fanout stops.
Creates a new draft by copying the source broadcast audience and exact owned message content.
Renders the broadcast-owned subject and body with optional preview variables without sending it.

get.description: Returns recipients captured for the broadcast, including delivery and exclusion state.
Returns the number of excluded broadcast recipients grouped by exclusion reason.
Returns aggregate delivery, bounce, complaint, open, and click metrics for the broadcast.

BearerAuth.description: Pass a Dugble team token in the Authorization header as Bearer <token>. Team token secrets use the dgb_team_ prefix.

LimitOffset.name: limit
LimitOffset.description: Maximum number of records to return. Most offset-paginated endpoints default to 50 and cap at 100.

SegmentLimit.name: limit
SegmentLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Omitted or non-positive values use 50; values above 100 are capped at 100. Malformed integers return 400.

SegmentOffset.name: offset
SegmentOffset.description: Number of records to skip. Omitted or negative values use 0. Malformed integers return 400.

EventLimit.name: limit
EventLimit.description: Maximum number of message events to return. Defaults to 100; values above 100 use the default.

CursorLimit.name: limit
CursorLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 20 and must be between 1 and 100.

After.name: after
After.description: Return records after this UUID cursor. Cannot be combined with before.

Before.name: before
Before.description: Return records before this UUID cursor. Cannot be combined with after.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for mutation requests. Maximum 256 characters.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Required unique key for email and SMS send requests. Maximum 256 characters.

Error.description: The request failed. See the HTTP status and structured error code for the category.

from.description: Optional sender override. When omitted, Dugble resolves the configured default sender.

scheduled_at.description: Future ISO 8601 date-time or supported relative schedule value.
Future RFC 3339 timestamp. Relative scheduling values are not accepted when rescheduling.
Future RFC 3339 timestamp at least 30 seconds ahead. Relative values are not accepted.
Future RFC 3339 timestamp or supported relative value such as 'in 5 min'. The resolved time must be at least 30 seconds ahead.

from.description: Email address, optionally with a display name.
Email address, optionally with a display name.

sms_consent_source.description: Required when an explicit SMS consent status is supplied.

ContactPropertyValue.description: Fallback value. Non-null values must match the contact property's declared type.

key.description: Unique property key containing only letters, numbers, and underscores.

type.description: Declared value type for the property.

fallback_value.description: Configured fallback value. Omitted when no fallback is set.

scheduled_at.description: When send is true, a future timestamp schedules delivery instead of queueing immediately.
